data.body: Investigation (BASIC): ROOT_CAUSE confirmed — When harvest-worktree.sh fails (exit 1/2/3), the post-merge worktree-removal block (lines 349-384, unlock+remove+prune) is never reached, leaving agent-* worktrees locked permanently. cleanup-claude-session.sh section 11 only runs git worktree prune (which skips locked worktrees), and end-session-cleanup.sh has no worktree handling. CONFIDENCE: high. 5 hypotheses confirmed empirically.
